thread:
Jesse (product): Heads-up — leadership wants a clear commitment for enterprise audit coverage in next sprint. We need to lock retention buckets, SLA for audit exports, and the acceptance criteria by EOD tomorrow.
Asha (eng-infra): Do we have a recommended retention tiering proposal to start from? I can estimate infra cost impact quickly.
Marta (security): Proposal: 90d hot (searchable), 365d warm (indexed but slower), 7y cold (archival, exportable on demand). This aligns w/ several enterprise needs.
Liam (legal): Quick flag — customers asking for 7+ years will need contractual language + potential data export time SLAs. Need a template clause.
Nikhil (ops): For SLA, are we talking export turnaround (e.g., 72h) or query SLA (e.g., search within platform <30s for hot)? These are operationally different.
Jesse (product): Good q. Leadership wants: search SLA for hot <=30s for last 90d, export turnaround 72h for warm/cold. Can we confirm feasibility?
Asha (eng-infra): Hot <=30s seems achievable with current indexing for expected QPS. 72h exports for warm/cold is fine but needs a job queue + backlog throttling. I estimate +2 infra tickets.
Marta (security): BYOK/KMS: any export of audit evidence that includes customer ciphertext metadata must be allowed under their key policy. We must define handshake and audit trail.
Liam (legal): I can draft the key-handoff clause. Also require customer acknowledgement for escrow requests.
Nikhil (ops): Runbook draft — ops oncall will need an export playbook and escalation path. Suggest adding an automated status page entry when an export is queued.
Jesse (product): Acceptance criteria (draft): 1) Hot search latency SLO validated on 3 sample tenants, 2) Export job triggered and completed within 72h in staging for 2TB sample, 3) KMS handshake logs recorded and surfaced to tenant audit view, 4) Legal-approved contract language exists.
Asha (eng-infra): I'll own #1 and #2. Will open infra tickets and include cost delta.
Marta (security): I'll own KMS handshake spec and logging. Quick note: add HMAC of export manifest to verify integrity.
Liam (legal): I'll produce the contract language tomorrow AM and ping compliance for review.
Nikhil (ops): I'll write the runbook skeleton, include the alerting playbook and a sample `export-status` slack alert.
retention-bot: Reminder: retention buckets template v1 is available at /internal/retention/templates/v1.json
Jesse (product): Great. Can we get a canary plan? Only permit enterprise tenants with feature flag for 2 weeks then broaden. Also need rollback criteria (e.g., export failures >5% or latency regressions >25%).
Asha (eng-infra): Canary plan acked. Will add metric thresholds and an automated rollback flag.
Marta (security): Also test key rotation during a live export as a canary edge-case.
Liam (legal): If production canary touches customer data, ensure consent language is in place. Will update template.
Jesse (product): OK final asks: everyone add a short note in the ticket with risks and the owner. We'll review tomorrow 11:00am. If anyone can't make it, ping here. :calendar: :eyes:
Asha (eng-infra): Added infra tickets and cost estimate.
Marta (security): Added KMS spec PR link in the ticket.
Liam (legal): Contract clause draft posted.
Nikhil (ops): Runbook PR opened, basic alerts wired to #eng-oncall.
Jesse (product): Thanks — I'll collate and send the decision memo after the review.
